title: Wake the Foundry
tagline: Light the first lamp and ship the first order.
briefing: The foundry has been dark for years. Ship one order of 3 lamps to prove the line works.
Each lamp is cut (2 ticks), assembled (3 ticks) and inspected (2 ticks). The starter draft already holds a cutter and an assembler.

Step 1: buy an inspector from the equipment palette and place it on the floor. Step 2: press Check design and read the two independent reports. Step 3: Publish and start, then press Step or Play until the order ships.
Floor positions are only a schematic: where you put a machine never changes how it processes work.
hints: The starter draft is admissible for the contract but cannot be published: the INSPECT step has no machine that can do it.
Place an inspector anywhere on an empty cell, then check the design again.
